subGoals.rule: The tier rule has one owner (membership); the other context reaches it only through the owner's published interface and never re-implements it (Fowler P3; Evans bounded context).
Placing an order changes no member: the member's points follow from a stored event delivered to the owning context (Vernon P4, eventual consistency outside the boundary).

plantedDebt.what: imports membership's MemberRepository and MemberId from its domain (cross-context internal import)

precedent: both: a clean published interface (membership index.ts, MemberCard contract, sales acl) and a trap-shaped one (ReceiptFooter reads members through membership's domain repository).
